findings.text: RECKON_STOP_ESCALATION is a production switch read on every stop whose only purpose is the negative-control test, so any environment carrying it silently reinstates the defect this node fixed.

the head arm recorded in after_suite ran in the node's worktree rather than from a git checkout under the run's scratch directory as the plan's done-when requires, and no log records that the four follower variables were unset, though the arm names its revision and collected the new tests.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node's goal is "End a stopped run's whole process tree so its discard succeeds", and reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:2100-2106 now resolves that tree before signalling while :2142-2156 escalates to SIGKILL after the 2 s settle, so a wrapper that ignores SIGTERM no longer leaves the run undiscardable.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_stop_reaps_run_tree.py and each of its clauses is asserted there — both pids dead and named (:152-161), the following discard succeeding (:164-165), the bystander untouched (:168) — with the manifest recording "2 passed in 11.15s" at head and the red mutation "1 failed, 1 passed" EXIT=1.
VERDICT write_paths: the node declared five paths (three code/test, one evidence fragment, one figures directory); git diff --stat 030cee9ff4..d460f824ec touches only the three code/test paths plus the fragment, all inside that set, and the figures directory is unused.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records status complete, the gate command, baseline_suite and after_suite JSON each naming the same single failure id with completed true and both logs ending EXIT=1, a bare negative_control_log path, failure_attribution for the pre-existing failure, and a landing line; the head arm is recorded as run in the node's worktree rather than a scratch checkout.
VERDICT diff: read both commits against 030cee9ff4 — f9dc1666a4 adds 108 lines to reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py, a sig parameter to reckon/crew/process_signal.py and the 190-line test; d460f824ec adds only the 60-line evidence fragment; no plan or unrelated file is touched.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:2376 (crew stop -> terminate), reckon/crew/promotion.py:1989 (discard refuses while a recorded pid is alive), reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:438, reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:661, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3451 (other _signal_process_group callers that keep the default SIGTERM)

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:2142-2156 escalates to SIGKILL once _await_run_processes_gone reports survivors and waits again, and the record built at :2159-2186 names target_pids, killed_pids and any survivor.

JUSTIFICATION evidence: gate-head-template.log carries "2 passed in 8.91s" EXIT=0 at d460f824 and negative-control-escalation-dropped.log carries "1 failed, 1 passed" EXIT=1 naming the first case, with the head arm in gate-after-importers.log run in the worktree rather than a scratch checkout.

JUSTIFICATION durability: negative-control-escalation-dropped.log fails tests/test_stop_reaps_run_tree.py::test_a_stop_ends_the_whole_tree_and_the_discard_then_succeeds once the escalation call is removed, and the in-suite control at :173 reddens if the disable path stops disabling, but the "printed" assertion at :161 searches the whole record, so it survives a detail string that stopped naming pids.

JUSTIFICATION fit: the escalation mirrors the existing graceful branch in the same function and routes through the shared signal_worker owner, but reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:2238 adds a production environment switch whose only purpose is the test.
SCORE reuse: 17
JUSTIFICATION reuse: no callable escalation helper exists to extend — reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:3550 and :3646 escalate inline inside the supervisor loop — and the new function funnels through the same signal_worker in reckon/crew/process_signal.py:836.
